description: Work out the gold content and melt value in pounds of a gold coin or bar (sovereigns, Britannias, Krugerrands and other 1 oz coins, or bars from 1 g to 1 kg) at Hopi's live mid-market gold price (updated hourly). With a dealer's price and buy-back it returns the premium over melt, the cost per gram of pure gold, the round-trip cost and the rise in gold needed to break even, and says whether the coin is free of UK Capital Gains Tax. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/gold-coin-value-calculator/

buybackEach.description: Optional: what a dealer would pay you for one, in pounds

fineness.description: custom only: purity in parts per 1,000, such as 916.7 or 999.9

priceEach.description: Optional: the dealer's selling price for one, in pounds

product.description: The coin or bar. Use custom with weightGrams and fineness for anything else.

weightGrams.description: custom only: weight of one item in grams
